title: Rescuing fertility: C-Phycocyanin prevents ovarian damage through NRF2-mediated ferroptosis pathways in polycystic ovary syndrome models.
authors: Zhang, Jing; Shen, Qun-Shan; Chen, Ya-Xin; Cheng, Hui-Ru; Zhang, Wei; Xing, Ting; Liu, Ya-Jing; Cao, Yun-Xia; Liang, Dan; Luo, Man; Yu, Biao
one_liner_zh: 该文研究C-藻蓝蛋白通过NRF2/AMPK通路抑制颗粒细胞铁死亡治疗多囊卵巢综合征，虽含分子对接但对象为蛋白-小分子互作，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA体系无关。
abstract: Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS), a common female endocrine disorder marked by disrupted folliculogenesis and hyperandrogenism, is increasingly linked to oxidative stress. Despite this association, the mechanistic basis remains poorly characterized. C-Phycocyanin (C-PC), a cyanobacteria-derived protein with potent antioxidant properties, has demonstrated therapeutic potential for treating PCOS, though the molecular pathways mediating its effects have yet to be delineated. This study employed both a dehydroepiandrosterone (DHEA)-induced murine model and DHEA-challenged human granulosa cells (KGN) to elucidate the regulatory role of C-PC. In vivo, oral administration of C-PC restored estrous cyclicity, reduced the prevalence of cystic follicles, and normalized circulating levels of testosterone, estradiol, progesterone, and luteinizing hormone (LH). In vitro, C-PC treatment activated the NRF2/xCT/GPX4 pathway, enhanced antioxidant activity, improved mitochondrial function, and suppressed ferroptotic death. Direct molecular interaction between C-PC and NRF2 was validated through molecular docking and cellular thermal shift assays (CETSA). Correspondingly, in vivo administration alleviated oxidative stress, inhibited ferroptosis, and increased GPX4 and xCT expression, effects reversed by pharmacological inhibition (ML385) and genetic silencing (AAV-sh-NRF2) of NRF2. C-PC also reduced DHEA-induced phosphorylation of AMPK, while co-treatment with an AMPK activator attenuated its effects on GPX4 and xCT, abolishing its anti-ferroptotic protection against granulosa cells. These findings suggest that C-PC mitigates PCOS pathology by repressing granulosa cell ferroptosis through coordinated activation of NRF2 and modulation of redox-sensitive AMPK signaling, highlighting its potential as a redox-targeted therapeutic strategy for PCOS.
abstract_zh: 多囊卵巢综合征（PCOS）是一种常见的女性内分泌疾病，以卵泡发育障碍和雄激素过多为特征，日益与氧化应激相关联。尽管存在这种关联，其机制基础仍未被充分阐明。C-藻蓝蛋白（C-PC）是一种源自蓝藻的蛋白质，具有强效抗氧化特性，在治疗PCOS方面显示出治疗潜力，但介导其作用的分子通路尚未明确。本研究采用脱氢表雄酮（DHEA）诱导的小鼠模型和DHEA刺激的人颗粒细胞（KGN），以阐明C-PC的调控作用。在体内，口服C-PC恢复了发情周期，减少了囊性卵泡的发生率，并使睾酮、雌二醇、孕酮和黄体生成素（LH）的循环水平恢复正常。在体外，C-PC处理激活了NRF2/xCT/GPX4通路，增强了抗氧化活性，改善了线粒体功能，并抑制了铁死亡。通过分子对接和细胞热位移分析（CETSA）验证了C-PC与NRF2之间的直接分子相互作用。相应地，体内给药减轻了氧化应激，抑制了铁死亡，并增加了GPX4和xCT的表达，这些效应可被NRF2的药理学抑制（ML385）和基因沉默（AAV-sh-NRF2）所逆转。C-PC还降低了DHEA诱导的AMPK磷酸化，而AMPK激活剂的联合处理减弱了其对GPX4和xCT的作用，并消除了其对颗粒细胞的抗铁死亡保护。这些发现表明，C-PC通过协同激活NRF2和调节氧化还原敏感的AMPK信号通路，抑制颗粒细胞铁死亡，从而缓解PCOS病理，凸显其作为PCOS氧化还原靶向治疗策略的潜力。
